summary.text: Kristofer Williams is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Ann Meyer (R) is also running.
A community organizer, Williams is a first-time candidate, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Williams graduated from West Lyon High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Bellevue University in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives about a mile west of Fort Dodge and that his family moved more than 30 times before he turned 18.
Williams advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
In the survey, he said he does not accept corporate money and listed clean water, fair taxes, and putting people over profit among his key messages.
